name: Flower-Catalogue-Website
description: A sophisticated full-stack MERN botanical encyclopedia and curation platform. Features a custom botanical classification engine, interactive filtering, and personalized user collections.

paragraphs: Peony is a sophisticated, full-stack botanical encyclopedia designed to bridge the gap between complex biological data and an elegant, highly visual user experience. Built on the MERN stack, the application serves as both a comprehensive catalog of 200 uniquely classified flowers and a personal curation tool for botanical enthusiasts. The architecture is engineered to handle deep, multi-parameter database queries seamlessly without sacrificing frontend performance or fluid UI animations.
features: Extensive Database: A robust backend cataloging 200 uniquely classified flowers with deep metric associations.

Advanced Multi-Parameter Filtering: Users can seamlessly query the database based on highly specific traits, including color, petal shape, type, and symbolism, utilizing a highly optimized Mongoose schema.
Secure Login: Integrated user authentication supporting both seamless Google OAuth and custom OTP (One Time Password) email verification.
Personalized Collections: Authenticated users can securely curate and save their own personal collections of favorite flowers directly to their profile database.
Interactive UI: Fluid page transitions, modal reveals, and interactive card elements powered by Framer Motion, delivering a polished and responsive frontend experience.
